title: panel harvest: both seats' fixes tested, composed, and a defect NEITHER could see repaired
verbatim: panel harvest: both seats' fixes tested, composed, and a defect NEITHER could see repaired HIS INSTRUCTION: "test it to ensure their solutions work and apply cleanly, and then fix the ones that do not." Done by execution, not by reading. Nothing was auto-applied: every fix below was run, cross-tested against the OTHER seat's falsifier, and mutation-verified in both directions. THE SEATS' FALSIFIERS ARE GENUINE: 21 of 31 of their tests FAIL on the unfixed tree (67.7419%, Wilson [50.1410%, 81.4306%], statsmodels against a numpy closed form agreeing to 1.11e-16). No file was wholly vacuous. 1b, THE INTEGRITY GATE THAT REFUSED A CORRECT FALSIFIER. Both seats fixed it by different mechanisms and each argued its own in prose. MEASURED over the 4 interpreters on this machine, the prose was BACKWARDS: fable's "more robust" subprocess probe covered 2 of 4, cc2's declared root list covered 3 of 4, and the composition of fable's mechanism with full discovery plus sysconfig paths covers 4 of 4. cc2's hard-coded paths are therefore NOT applied -- measured redundant under the composed form, not judged redundant. Producer: scripts/interpreter_allowlist_coverage_2026-10-12.py. MY OWN INSTRUMENT WAS WRONG FIRST: it counted roots that do not exist on disk as coverage gaps, which read the composed fix as 1 of 4 when it is 4 of 4. A directory that is not on disk can never be read, so it can never be denied. 1c, AND THIS IS THE FINDING NEITHER SEAT COULD SEE. fable SERVES a never-served finding up the ladder so a tool can decide it; cc2 opens a DOOR so one nothing ever touched stops blocking, with a paired reader so the exclusion is never silent. Each passes its own falsifier and fails the other's -- neither dominates. COMPOSED, they were STRICTLY WORSE THAN EITHER ALONE: serving writes routing_history, and an empty routing_history was one of the facts the door required, so THE SERVE CONSUMED THE DOOR'S OWN TRIGGER. A C0066-shaped entry served to a ladder returning UNRESOLVED went from (A4=0, released and named) to (A4=1, door empty) -- blocking for ever again with neither mechanism able to release it. Neither seat could see it: each tested its own fix alone, and alone each is correct. THE REPAIR distinguishes SERVED-AND-NO-READING from SERVED-AND-RULED on the resolved flag plus an explicit NO_READING_ROUTING_VERDICTS sentinel set that FAILS CLOSED -- any verdict string not in that tiny set is a ruling. z3 proves door_open AND a_ruling_exists is UNSAT and that the door is still reachable (SAT), with SymPy agreeing. cc2's own UNTOOLABLE case stays green because UNTOOLABLE is not in the set: an instrument that ran and ruled still blocks. All 57 tests across both seats' suites and the 2 adjacent suites pass, and NO test was weakened to get there. AND cc2's RECORD PATCH WOULD HAVE DELETED TWO OF HIS RULINGS. Its task-list hunks removed the R1 block carrying his Exp 53 ruling and the sim-only inventory it implies, and reverted task 10.2 from WITHDRAWN back to BLOCKED, undoing his Tailscale ruling including his verbatim words. Neither is mentioned anywhere in its reply. Only its A19 hunk (+14, -0) is applied. This is exactly why fixes are SUGGESTED to HIL and never auto-applied. THE 2 RED ON THE BOARD ARE CLOSED, both false reds on correct mechanisms: B2 -- the simulated-run invariant restated 2 of the audit's 3 exclusion rules and omitted _is_seat_scratch, so it went red when the 2026-10-05 panel harvested a seat's own synthetic fixture. It now CALLS the producer's predicate. Mutation at the right call site (line 399, not the first occurrence -- my first mutation hit the wrong one and falsely passed) turns it red, so the teeth are proved. B1 -- the exp52 omission check looked only inside _dispatch_single_model, a THIN WRAPPER; the live wiring is at :11041 in _dispatch_single_model_inner. It now resolves the delegation through bench/tests/_delegation.py. Deleting the real wiring still turns it red. PARKED ITEM 18 FIXED, named by both seats and written by neither: blocker_triage.py answered 2 of the 3 questions its own header names. A8, whose text ends "NEEDS A POLICY RULING", triaged as a bare PARK, and the Stop hook reads PARK as "carry on" -- so the hook pushed toward DOING a thing the entry says is his to decide. decision_required is a THIRD FLAG, not a third verdict, because folding two of the three together is the defect the first version shipped. classify() keeps its 3-tuple so no caller changes shape. PARKED ITEM 3 (A13/A14) IS STALE, as fable warned before anyone wrote a fix: its premise is that both seats share one sandbox. Today's own run gave 2 distinct sandbox roots for 2 seats, and test_fresh_sandbox_per_attempt 2026-09-17 passes 11 tests -- fixed a week AFTER the item was parked. STILL OWED AND NOT CLAIMED: parked items 1 and 2 are specified and unwritten; both seats deferred them under budget and so do I rather than claim them. The JOINT ROUND for this blind round has not run and the board enforces that debt. title: WITHDRAWN: no seat deleted his rulings. The diff direction did, and I accused cc2 of it.
verbatim: WITHDRAWN: no seat deleted his rulings. The diff direction did, and I accused cc2 of it. THE CLAIM I MADE, one commit ago, in b912268d: "cc2's RECORD PATCH WOULD HAVE DELETED TWO OF HIS RULINGS ... Neither is mentioned anywhere in its reply. This is exactly why fixes are SUGGESTED to HIL and never auto-applied." I named a seat and said it had removed the founder's own words from the record. WHAT REFUTED IT. fable's harvested diff carries the SAME two removals, verbatim. Two seats sandboxed separately and blind to each other cannot coincidentally delete the same two blocks of the same file. That is a common cause, and the common cause is the DIFF DIRECTION: sandbox created, cc2 2026-10-12 19:15:13 sandbox created, fable 2026-10-12 19:15:33 --- the LIVE repository file 2026-10-12 19:16:09 +++ the seat's sandbox copy 2026-10-12 19:30:42 (cc2) 2026-10-12 14:58:44 (fable, untouched) Both clones predate 19:16:09, so neither ever held that edit -- which was MY OWN, recording his Exp 53 ruling and the withdrawal of task 10.2, written 36 seconds after cc2's sandbox was cut. A line present in the live file and absent from an older clone appears with a leading minus, which reads identically to a deletion. fable never touched that file at all. cc2's only edit to it is the additive A19 correction, which is applied and which is good work. WHAT STANDS AND WHAT DOES NOT. The DECISION was right: only the additive A19 hunk (+14, -0) went in, and copying either seat's whole file would genuinely have reverted his two rulings out of the tree, because both copies predate them. The REASON recorded was wrong, and the difference is not cosmetic -- one version accuses a seat of destroying the founder's words and the other describes a stale clone base. Scope of the failure: the attribution, not the handling. THE CLASS IS A PREDICATE CHECKED AGAINST THE WRONG BASELINE, and it is the same class as 2 other errors in this session: an interpreter-coverage instrument that counted roots not present on disk, and a mutation applied to the first of two call sites rather than the operative one. All 3 were caught by asking what else could produce this reading, and all 3 would have been caught sooner by asking it first. Producer: scripts/no_seat_deleted_his_rulings_2026-10-12.py, which asserts the common cause rather than describing it and exits 3 if the timestamps ever stop supporting it. The FULL RECORD note is corrected in place, with the withdrawal and its refutation kept beside the original claim rather than the claim being deleted. title: joint round: both seats refuted their own blind answer, and mine was INERT
verbatim: joint round: both seats refuted their own blind answer, and mine was INERT THE JOINT HALF WAS OWED AND THE BOARD ENFORCED IT. The blind round's replies had been tested and partly applied; the half where the seats see each other's work had not run. Free seats only, pinned explicitly -- the first dispatch attempt was refused by the brief gate, which reported 5 seats selected with 3 of them PAID. That gate prevented an unauthorised spend. paid_seats: []. MY OWN COMPOSITION REPAIR WAS INERT, AND THIS IS THE FINDING OF THE ROUND. After the blind half I separated SERVED-AND-NO-READING from SERVED-AND-RULED, keyed on NO_READING_ROUTING_VERDICTS = {"", "UNRESOLVED"}, and verified it against 3 outcomes -- all 3 produced with a stubbed ladder result whose verdict I chose myself. fable enumerated the live ladder's reachable verdicts and found the intersection EMPTY. Confirmed from source (bench/routing.py:207 initialises last_verdict to "UNTOOLABLE" and only ever reassigns to "ERROR" or a reverify_fn verdict) and then measured across the archive: 0 of 311 archived ladder records carry a verdict my set matches, Wilson 95% [0.0000%, 1.2201%]. The door could never open after a real serve. The defect I reported as fixed STOOD. Producer: scripts/my_sentinel_set_matched_nothing_2026-10-12.py. WHAT MAKES IT LIVE is fable's fix: the transport-dead path, where no rung reached any model, appended a record asserting an ERROR ruling -- a false claim that something read the finding. Reclassified to a no-reading record with rungs_reached 0, the door opens, names the entry, and the ladder may retry. Measured on the composed tree: record carries UNRESOLVED, A4 = 0, ladder_unserved_findings = [C9001], RE-SERVED. cc2's J1 FIX CLOSES A DIFFERENT AND SHARPER HOLE. Every conjunct of the door read a ladder, falsifier or escalation field, while the R_k proof checker writes to none of them -- so an entry whose proof had been computed and had FAILED was released anyway. The door was strictly WIDER than the severity gate whose removal he has rejected 4 times, and nullified it for that entry class. Of 431 non-terminal entries the pre-fix door released, 25 carried a proof result: a reading discarded on 5.80%, Wilson [3.96%, 8.42%]. ALL THREE ARE NEEDED AND THE COMPOSITION WAS TESTED, NOT ASSUMED. Each fix alone passes its own falsifier and fails the other's. Composed: 13 + 6 + 6 + 18 + 20 + 15 green across both seats' suites, mine, and the 2 adjacent suites. The age bound was challenged rather than accepted and measured: 230 of 230 ladder-served entries were served in their arrival round, Wilson lower bound 98.36%, so a longer lock buys no service. THE SEVERITY GATE: BOTH SEATS REFUTED THEIR OWN BLIND-ROUND ANSWER, AND I HAD ALREADY REPORTED THAT ANSWER TO HIM AS PROBABLY SETTLING HIS TENSION. Two levels. Level 1, the recomputation checks ARITHMETIC ONLY: wholly invented but mutually consistent inputs return PASS, with nothing cross-checked against any harness-held value. Level 2, and it is decisive: THE PROVEN QUANTITY IS NOT THE GATED QUANTITY. Release reads the proof STATUS and the raw severity float; the proof recomputes R_k from R_k's own inputs and NEVER READS severity. A proof whose content states R_k = 0.95 releases a 0.45 float, and A4 falls 1 -> 0 on exactly that proof. MEASURED INDEPENDENTLY OF BOTH SEATS over 521 archived entries carrying a PASS/WARN proof: Pearson r = -0.3438, p = 6.689e-16, 95% CI [-0.4174, -0.2657], numpy agreeing to 5.55e-17; Spearman rho = -0.3454. The proven figure explains 11.82% of the variance in the float it licenses and THE SIGN IS NEGATIVE. Tying the proof to the released number would stop 434 of 521 (83.30%) currently-proven entries from being released at the proof's own 0.05 tolerance. That is a large gate movement, it turns on what severity is to be computed FROM (residual risk and impact are different quantities), and it is HIS RULING, not the panel's. Producer: scripts/the_proven_number_is_not_the_gated_number_2026-10-12.py. WHAT REMAINS TRUE, so the correction does not overshoot: the gate is not a no-op. title: his ruling 3: a never-read finding is FED BACK, never excused. Release withdrawn.
verbatim: his ruling 3: a never-read finding is FED BACK, never excused. Release withdrawn. HIS RULING, 2026-10-12, VERBATIM: "No. If a record exists that says a problem was never read by a model, this should simply be fed back into the mechanics of the harness for resolution, this can include routing, the sweep mechanics and the other machinery we have for dealing with problems of this nature." WHAT WAS WRONG WITH WHAT I BUILT. The door EXCUSED a never-read finding from the blocker count once it was a round old, so a run could record a clean convergence over a finding no instrument had ever examined. That is an exclusion, not a resolution. He is ruling that the finding must be WORKED. ALL 3 PATHS HE NAMED, AND THE THIRD ONE NEEDED BUILDING: ROUTING -- already active from the joint round: `_apply_routing` admits a never-served entry and RE-admits it while no reading comes back, so a tool is asked every round rather than once. THE SWEEP -- already active: `_post_convergence_sweep` takes every non-terminal finding as a residual. The PRE-verdict sweep shadow, which records whether sweeping before the verdict would change it, HAS NEVER RECORDED -- measured: 0 archived reports carry the field, because it was added 2026-10-06T07:04 and the newest experiment report (study_run1b_2026-10-03) predates it by 3 days. Not a defect; the next simulated run produces its first data point, and its promotion criterion is already written in the code. THE HALT MACHINERY -- BUILT HERE. `_irreducible_queue_split` skipped everything below CRITICAL_SEVERITY_THRESHOLD, so the 2 findings that stopped study_run1b converging -- C0066 at 0.45 and C0073 at 0.50, neither ever read by any instrument -- reached the halt-with-evidence-bundle machinery NOT AT ALL. Executed on that registry before the change: ladder-exhausted 0, never-assessed 0, total 0. A never-read finding now reaches it AT ANY SEVERITY and is classed `deferred`, not `locked`, because the 2026-09-07 panel repair deliberately stopped stamping `irreducible_escalation` on findings the instrument never read. THE TUPLE SHAPE IS UNCHANGED so no caller moves. THE RESIDUAL, STATED NOT HIDDEN, AND IT IS HIS TUNING CALL. The alarm fires only ABOVE `max_irreducible_queue` (default 2). Measured on study_run1b the 2 survivors put the queue at exactly 2, which is not over the bound -- so 1 or 2 unresolvable never-read findings still block A4 without tripping the alarm, and such a run reaches max_rounds rather than halting with a bundle. Lowering the bound, or giving this class its own, is a tuning decision and is not one to take quietly inside a predicate. It is pinned by test_the_live_run_reaches_the_halt_machinery so it fails loudly if it changes. 9 TESTS PINNED THE RELEASE AND ALL 9 ARE REPLACED, NOT WEAKENED. Each says in place what changed and why. The pattern: where one asserted "A4 falls to 0 because the door released it", the replacement asserts 3 facts -- it KEEPS BLOCKING, it is NAMED by the paired reader, and it REACHES the halt queue. Two live-registry tests had their ADVICE reversed: both earlier drafts said study_run1b could be cleared, the first by releasing at round 7 and the second by "one more round" at round 8. An extra round does not make an unread finding read, so the replacement asserts the count stays 2 at rounds 7, 8, 9 and 20, and that what clears it is a tool reading C0066 and C0073. WHAT SURVIVES THE WITHDRAWAL, and it is worth naming because it would be easy to discard with the door. cc2's `severity_proof` conjunct is STILL a correctness fix, because `ladder_unserved_findings` shares the predicate: an entry whose proof was computed and FAILED was read by an instrument, and naming it as never-read would be false. And `LADDER_UNSERVED_MIN_AGE_ROUNDS` still governs the REPORT for its original measured reason -- 230 of 230 ladder-served entries were served in their arrival round, so a finding emitted this round has not been passed over and must not be reported as skipped. 93 passed across the 8 affected suites. Mutation: restoring the release turns 8 of them red. Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5 <noreply@anthropic.com> BACKFILLED from project history on his instruction of 2026-10-17. Kind 'pf' comes from the stated first-word rule in scripts/backfill_the_register_from_history_2026-10-17.py, not from anyone's classification. Author: jebus197.

verbatim: his ruling 2: the fix EXISTS and is built. A falsifier can no longer read our evidence. HIS CHALLENGE, 2026-10-12, VERBATIM: "Then what is the fix? If the models didn't suggest any, and you didn't devise any, then that is not an ideal outcome. (Or a good use of available resources.) A better outcome would be to derive the optimal fix, then test it in the upcoming simulated run and program of study. In general my job as the HIL is to rule on matters that are non-computationally reducible. You appear to be implying here that no resolution can exist? Is that accurate?" IT WAS NOT ACCURATE AND HE WAS RIGHT TO PRESS. Both seats DID specify the same fix; neither wrote it; and I reported the decision to him as though the absence of a fix were a property of the problem. The missing piece was a MEASUREMENT, not a resolution, and cc2 named it exactly: "a scratch-path inventory across archived falsifiers ... One line of code, one measurement I did not have time to take." THE MEASUREMENT, TAKEN. Across 1,360 archived falsifier sources, 0 name a run or panel evidence region -- Wilson 95% [0.0000%, 0.2817%], Clopper-Pearson [0.0000%, 0.2709%]. So the blast radius of denying those regions is zero on the whole archive. Producer: scripts/does_any_falsifier_read_the_evidence_2026-10-12.py. AND THE MEASUREMENT DREW THE BOUNDARY RATHER THAN CONFIRMING A GUESS. Denying ALL of `experimental_notes/` would have refused 1 HONEST falsifier: C0061 in commissioning_arm1_panel_20260929T214647Z reads `CDSFL_MASTER_TASK_LIST.md` to demonstrate that a test file parses the task list at import time. So the canonical task list stays READABLE and the evidence subtrees do not. That is 3 of 1,360 sources at 0.2206% for the wide form against 0 for the narrow one, and it is the difference between a tier that is safe and a tier that breaks a working falsifier. THE FIX. `_is_evidence(path)` in the observer template, checked in `_denied` BESIDE `_protected` and BEFORE the allowlist. Matched on PATH SEGMENTS, not absolute roots, which is what lets one tier close every route at once: the real repository, a staged clone under the temp directory, and every sibling panel sandbox. fable established why placement decides it -- narrowing the temp allowance alone would NOT close the hole, because the clone root grants the same reads independently. `_protected` is untouched and still checked first, so the sealed scoring key store is refused exactly as before. EXECUTED AGAINST THE REAL RENDERED OBSERVER, not a reconstruction: this exam's own prior round (bench/logs/.../cc2.json) DENIED mirrored panel evidence (experimental_notes/evidence/) DENIED harvested seat files (seat_evidence/, sandbox_harvest/) DENIED a SIBLING sandbox's evidence DENIED CDSFL_MASTER_TASK_LIST.md readable bench/reference_runner_v3.py readable docs/MATHEMATICAL_APPENDIX.md readable ~/.config/cdsfl/scoring.env DENIED (by _protected) A DATED SEGMENT WAS IN THE FIRST DRAFT AND IS GONE. `panel_records_2026-10-12` covers one day and rots on the next; the mirrored records already sit under `experimental_notes/evidence/`, which the predicate covers by its own branch. title: his ruling 1: the severity specification EXISTS, was never implemented, and he is right
verbatim: his ruling 1: the severity specification EXISTS, was never implemented, and he is right HIS QUESTION AND RULING, 2026-10-12, VERBATIM: "What was the original specification for the severity gate? Severity was supposed to be calculated in accordance with our existing maths model. If the models are asked to compute anything it should surely be computed from our maths model and from what this already says about severity surely, then they must provide a proof to demonstrate that they have computed severity correctly, then the other machinery of the schema should apply a working falsifier/use tools to check that this number makes sense and checks out. This does not qualify as a 'vote'. Indeed it is the very opposite of a vote." THE ANSWER, AND IT VINDICATES HIM ON ALL THREE COUNTS. docs/MATHEMATICAL_APPENDIX.md section 7.7 specifies: Sev(f) = W(class) . confidence . V(verification) W(HARD)=1.0 W(SOFT)=0.5; V(True)=1.0 V(None)=0.5 V(False)=0.0 TWO OF THE THREE FACTORS BELONG TO THE HARNESS, NOT THE MODEL. The constraint class is a HARD/SOFT classification the schema already governs; the verification factor is the falsifier outcome the harness computes itself. Only `confidence` is the model's to assert. And the section states its own KEY PROPERTY: "Disproved findings always receive zero severity, regardless of confidence. A model that is very confident about something wrong gets zero credit." A tool outcome ANNIHILATES the model's number. That is structurally the opposite of a vote, exactly as he says, and it is written down in the model he asked me to check. IT WAS NEVER IMPLEMENTED. The product is computed NOWHERE in live code. `bench/reference_runner_v3.py:6682` reads `severity=float(entry.get("severity") or 0.0)` straight from the model's parsed output. AND TWO OF ITS INPUTS WERE NEVER EVEN COLLECTED. Across 3,298 archived entries, `confidence` appears on 0 of them and no field carries a HARD/SOFT class (`flaw_class` is section 4's integer class identifier, a different quantity). THE DECISIVE TEST IS THE APPENDIX'S OWN KEY PROPERTY, AND THE IMPLEMENTATION FAILS IT: 35 of 40 disproved (REFUTED) findings carry NON-ZERO severity -- 87.5000%, Wilson 95% [73.8879%, 94.5405%], Clopper-Pearson [73.1967%, 95.8140%]. Section 7.7 forbids that by construction. Producer: scripts/severity_was_never_computed_from_the_model_2026-10-12.py. SO THE TENSION DISSOLVES, AND THE 2026-09-06 REMOVAL FIXED THE WRONG THING. Its argument -- a model-assigned number must not decide convergence, there are no votes in CDSFL -- was SOUND ABOUT THE IMPLEMENTATION AND WRONG ABOUT THE SPECIFICATION. The remedy that argument licensed was removal. The remedy the specification licenses is to COMPUTE it. His instinct and his ruling are the same thing, and no further panel round is needed to establish the diagnosis. WHAT IS BUILT NOW, AND IT GATES NOTHING. `FindingRegistry.severity_spec_shadow` applies the one factor available without a schema change -- V, from the harness's OWN falsifier verdict, which is precisely the step he describes as "the other machinery of the schema should apply a working falsifier". It is wired into the round telemetry beside the round budget and the review trigger, and it is a SHADOW because the measured movement is large: the share at or above the 0.7 cut falls from 41.6313% (Wilson [39.9596%, 43.3225%]) to 16.3129% ([15.0912%, 17.6130%]), with 835 of 3,298 entries crossing downward -- 25.3184%, Wilson [23.8636%, 26.8306%], Clopper-Pearson [23.8416%, 26.8391%]. Those are findings the gate calls critical and section 7.7 would not, because no tool has verified them. Producer: scripts/the_verification_factor_shadow_2026-10-12.py. WHAT NEEDS HIM, STATED SO IT IS NOT MISTAKEN FOR DONE. A 25-point reclassification is replay-invalidating, and this project's rule is that each promotion needs non-distortion evidence from a RUN first. The shadow exists so the next simulated run produces that evidence. And the remaining half of section 7.7 -- collecting `confidence` and the HARD/SOFT class so the full product can be computed, with the models proving their own computation -- is a SCHEMA change that alters every model's prompt, which the panel already flagged as belonging to one batched replay-invalidation decision rather than four separate ones. A TRAP IN A SHARED HELPER, FOUND BY FALLING INTO IT. The first version of this fix's wiring test asked `_delegation.callers_of` whether the shadow was wired. That helper matches BARE-NAME calls only, and this is a METHOD call, so it returned an empty set for wiring that exists -- a false negative of exactly the shape that module exists to prevent. The limitation is now documented in its docstring. Measured at the same time: all 3 other call sites in the suite target module-level functions, so NO existing guard is vacuous because of it. GUARD: bench/tests/test_the_severity_specification_shadow_2026-10-12.py, 7 tests, including that calling the shadow leaves the blocker count and the registry untouched. 2 mutations, each red: unwiring it from the telemetry, and disabling the key-property check. title: board triage: 13 red, 10 of them mine, and 2 were real defects in tonight's work
verbatim: board triage: 13 red, 10 of them mine, and 2 were real defects in tonight's work FULL BOARD, FRESH, ON HIS INSTRUCTION after killing the stale one: 13 failed, 11079 passed, 18 skipped in 3649.54 s (1:00:49). Reproduce with `python3 -m pytest bench/tests/ -q`. TWO WERE REAL DEFECTS IN MY OWN RULING-3 CHANGE, AND BOTH WERE CAUGHT BY TESTS THAT ALREADY EXISTED RATHER THAN BY INSPECTION. This is the part worth keeping. (1) `test_subcritical_irreducibles_do_not_trip_the_alarm`. I let a never-read finding past the queue's severity skip using `_routing_ladder_never_served`, which does NOT test `irreducible_escalation` -- because on the A4 path that flag is skipped several lines EARLIER and the predicate never sees such an entry. Asking it in a context with no such skip classified a LADDER-EXHAUSTED sub-critical as never-read: 5 escalated entries at severity 0.4 tripped an alarm that must stay silent. An exhausted ladder IS instrument contact. (2) `test_registry_irreducible_excluded_from_a4_blocker`. The corrected version then counted ANY never-read finding, including a critical that had only just arrived and was awaiting its first verification. 3 fresh criticals would have put the queue over the bound and HALTED a run that had barely started. The distinction is PASSED OVER versus NOT YET REACHED, and the ladder's own record carries it: a non-empty `routing_history` whose every record is a no-reading one. AND THE LIVE SHAPE THEN EXPOSED A THIRD GAP. Executed: 3 never-served sub-criticals served to an EMPTY ladder acquire `routing_deferred`, the severity skip excluded them, and the queue stayed at 0 -- so his ruling's halt path could never be reached for a sub-critical at all. A ladder-empty deferral means no writer was available besides the finding's own source, which is an absence of reading, not a ruling. Now included; `irreducible_escalation` still is not. NON-DISTORTION, MEASURED AGAINST THE TRUE BASELINE: over 69 archived registries, 8 are over the bound of 2 BOTH before and after -- identical, because the archive predates the routing fix and holds no served-but-unread entry. The mechanism is forward-looking by construction. A first attempt at this comparison was WRONG and is recorded as such: `git stash` removed only the uncommitted corrections, so the "baseline" it measured was the over-wide committed version at 34 of 69. The true baseline came from `git show 716248fd`. LIVE PATH NOW VERIFIED END TO END: 3 never-read sub-criticals -> queue 3 -> alarm FIRES, `action=halt_notify_attach`, count 3 against bound 2 -> the founder is handed an evidence bundle instead of the run burning to max_rounds. Guarded by 2 new tests, including the boundary case that an exhausted sub-critical still does NOT trip it. FIVE WERE MECHANICAL AND ARE FIXED. The 4 producers written in the joint round called `answer_help(__doc__)` at MODULE level, so merely importing them made the helper inspect `sys.argv` -- which under the suite's import probe holds the script's own path and is refused, exit 2. The flag is answered from `main()` now, still free. And 2 of tonight's scripts printed a listing capped at 6 and 8 without saying what they withheld; both now state the remainder. THE SCRIPT RATCHET IS CLOSED: 341 of 341 reached, 100.0000%, Wilson [98.8860%, 100.0000%]. The single orphan was `scripts/the_panel_harvest_numbers_2026-10-12.py` -- cited in commit messages, which are not tracked files, so nothing in the tree reached it. Now cited where its figures are used. B1 AND B2 ARE DONE, both by tonight's work and both meeting the DONE criteria their entries stated. B1's guard had a stale locator, not an unwired switch. B2's gap was in the TEST, not the audit -- and B2's own recorded diagnosis was wrong: it names `stage6_calibration_r0N.json`, and the extra admitted path is a seat's synthetic fixture harvested from the 2026-10-05 panel sandbox. Both corrections are recorded in the entries. STILL RED AND DELIBERATELY NOT FORCED GREEN, 2 ITEMS: `test_task_list_burndown` -- "on 2026-10-12 the list gained 2 entries and closed 0". With B1 and B2 closed that becomes 2 and 2, and the test requires closure to OUTPACE discovery, so it stays red. That is a TRUE statement about today: his 3 rulings generated real work. Closing a third entry to make it green would be gaming the metric, which is the behaviour the entry above B1 quotes him objecting to. `test_lint_reach_over_notes` -- the working tree declares note standard v1.7 in `Morning_Report_2026-10-12_GENERATED.md` where HEAD does not, while git reports the file clean. A selector-versus-revision-reader disagreement, not uncommitted work. Diagnosed no further at this hour and left RED rather than guessed at. title: the reader lost 946 characters of his writing, and the lost clause reordered the work
verbatim: the reader lost 946 characters of his writing, and the lost clause reordered the work HIS INSTRUCTION, 2026-10-13: "Make sure you can parse my responses in full." THE SECOND TIME HE HAS HAD TO SAY IT. On 2026-10-11 the reader decoded his files with errors="ignore" and silently dropped every curly apostrophe, 256 characters across 14 of 29 plain-text files. That was repaired. THIS is a different defect in the same reader, and it was found by obeying the same instruction rather than by assuming the earlier fix had settled the matter. THE DEFECT. `_annotations_in` walked the decoded text line by line and treated each line beginning with '#' as a WHOLE annotation. An annotation CONTINUING on a later line lost everything after the first, because a continuation does not itself begin with '#'. MEASURED ON THE FILE THAT EXPOSED IT. His first annotation on Morning_Report_2026-10-13.txt occupies lines 23, 25 and 27 of a Mac OS Roman, CR-terminated file: the hash line, 819 characters re-quoting his own earlier ruling, then its 127-character tail. The reader returned **97 of 1,053 characters**. THE LOST TEXT CARRIED THE OPERATIVE CLAUSE -- "But propose your own fixes first" -- which changes the ORDER of the work he asked for, and it survived only because the file was also read directly with the Read tool. THE RULE IS HIS OWN CONVENTION, NOT A HEURISTIC OVER HIS PROSE. A LEADING hash opens an annotation; a TRAILING hash says a quotation follows. The continuation then runs until the report resumes, and "the report" is read from the generated original in ~/Desktop/CDSFL_tts where one survives -- so the boundary is an ORACLE rather than a guess, because an annotated response file is a COPY of a report this project generated. A capitals-run heuristic is kept only as the fallback for a response whose original no longer exists, and it is labelled as nearly safe rather than safe: measured over his 522 annotations, exactly 1 of HIS OWN lines opens with 4 or more capitals, 0.1916%, Wilson 95% [0.0338%, 1.0771%]. WHY THE RULE IS NARROW. 1 of 522 annotations ends with a trailing hash -- 0.1916%, Wilson [0.0338%, 1.0771%], Clopper-Pearson [0.0049%, 1.0627%]. A rule that instead captured ANY following prose line would have swallowed 367 further lines, most of them the reports' own sentences, and over-capture is WORSE than truncation because it attributes our words to him. Producer: scripts/an_annotation_can_span_lines_2026-10-13.py. CORPUS INVARIANCE, AND THIS IS THE MEASUREMENT THAT MAKES THE FIX SAFE: 522 annotations before and after, 946 characters recovered, and EXACTLY ONE annotation's length changed -- Morning_Report_2026-10-13.txt line 23, 97 -> 1043. A reader fix that moved any other annotation would be changing the record rather than reading it. MUTATIONS, BOTH RED: removing the trailing-hash trigger returns 97 characters; and disabling the oracle leaves the heuristic fallback, which independently returns the same 1043 -- two methods agreeing on the boundary, which is the cross-verification the 21 Apr 2026 rule asks for. AND I DESTROYED THE FIX ONCE WHILE P-PASSING IT. A shell loop written to compare before and after copied the pre-fix file over the live one and then `git checkout` reverted it, so the first invariance measurement reported "0 characters recovered" against a file that no longer carried the fix. Caught because 0 was implausible, not because the loop was reviewed. The second version of that test was wrong too: it asserted at most 3 annotations exceed 900 characters, on the assumption that his are short -- measured, 26 of 522 do. It now asserts the property that matters, which is PROVENANCE rather than length: no annotation may contain a line verbatim from any report this project generated. GUARD: bench/tests/test_an_annotation_can_span_lines_2026-10-13.py, 5 tests. The reader's own suite is 9 passed; the triage, the parked cross-check and the span producer all still run, and the reader reports 0 gaps over 84 files. Kind 'pf' comes from the stated first-word rule in scripts/backfill_the_register_from_history_2026-10-17.py, not from anyone's classification. Author: jebus197.

title: panel fixes applied, the pruner RETIRED on his ruling, and 4 of my 5 proposals were refuted
verbatim: panel fixes applied, the pruner RETIRED on his ruling, and 4 of my 5 proposals were refuted HIS INSTRUCTIONS, 2026-10-13: "apply all collective fixes", and "I also agree the mechanical directive pruner should be retired. We have no way of knowing what it feeds, or has been feeding our models. We can achieve the same pruning goal by hand, probably with more accuracy, so that the models get fed the same set of core directives every single time an experiment is run." BOTH SEATS, FREE, paid_seats: [], cc2 957 s / 178 tool calls, fable 1360.5 s / 236. Each attacked MY OWN proposals as the brief required, under a, f and sy. **4 of my 5 proposals were refuted or found insufficient.** The one that survived is Item 4, and it survived for a reason I had not established. ITEM 5 -- HIS RULING, AND BOTH SEATS REFUTED THE MECHANISM I PROPOSED FOR IT. My step (3) was that a hand trim would leave the pruner nothing to do. cc2 measured it closing C0040 for 0 of 5 models: the 2026-07-18 review trims `cdsfl_operational.md`, which is appended UNCAPPED, while C0040 truncates `cdsfl_core_formal.md`; required cut 3.7x to 5.6x the review's own committed estimate, on a file it never measured; and the review forbids the edit in its own words. fable went further and showed my step was BACKWARDS: density rises as text shrinks, so trimming toward deepseek's 4,000-char cap GUARANTEES the pruner fires (trigger at 5,600 chars for budget 0.010) -- my fix would have INFLAMED C0001. **His ruling removes that hazard, because retiring first means the trim can never trigger it.** THE RETIREMENT, WITH THE MEASUREMENT THE REMOVAL CLAUSE DEMANDS, ON HIS 2 NAMED PROPERTIES. (1) THE PRUNER'S OWN OBJECTIVE: `_count_constraints` is independent of the composed text, so density can only RISE as text is deleted -- z3 unsat for "text shrank AND density did not worsen", SymPy, NumPy and mpmath agreeing, and the C0001 guard pinning it on real packets at 0.011851 -> 0.021042 against budget 0.010, 1.7756x worse. Identity dominates pruning on the metric pruning exists to optimise. (2) DETERMINISM, which is HIS ground and the stronger one: the 5 seats carry **4 DISTINCT density budgets** (0.01, 0.012, 0.015, 0.02), so the deletion set differs BY SEAT -- the same experiment feeds different directive text to different models and no record says which text any seat received. That is "no way of knowing what it feeds", measured. Producer: scripts/retiring_the_pruner_dominates_2026-10-13.py. NOTHING IS REMOVED: the mechanism stays reachable by flag at 5 sites, so the lean-versus-full ablation the review requires is still runnable. AND WHAT THE RETIREMENT DOES NOT FIX IS STATED RATHER THAN SOLD AS FREE: C0040's reduced rendering is a separate mechanism on a separate file and is untouched. TWO TESTS PINNED THE OLD DEFAULT AND BOTH ARE REPLACED, NOT WEAKENED. The ablation switch's "default is ON and byte-identical" is inverted and now also asserts the flag still turns it back on -- a retirement that removed the mechanism would breach the additive standard, one that left the default on would not be a retirement, and both halves are pinned. And the C0001 harm test read `assert lost > 0, "no domain directive is deleted any more"` -- a characterisation that went RED the moment the harm stopped. It is now TWO-SIDED and strictly stronger: with the pruner retired 0 compositions lose a domain directive, and with it switched back ON the loss returns, so a lapse in either direction is caught. ITEM 1, SEVERITY -- BOTH SEATS SAID INSUFFICIENT AND cc2 FOUND THE COLLAPSE. At the 0.7 cut, `Sev >= 0.7` is IDENTICALLY `HARD AND CONFIRMED AND conf >= 0.7`, and inside that one surviving cell `Sev = confidence` exactly, derivative 1 -- so the harness factors are a conjunctive pre-filter on ELIGIBILITY and place no constraint on MAGNITUDE. His "opposite of a vote" holds for eligibility and FAILS for magnitude: the same vote over a smaller population. SymPy, z3 and Wolfram Language (local Engine) third-sourced it. And 2 further refutations of my proposal: part (4) was ALREADY BUILT (the shadow, wired, with an anti-dead-code assertion -- proposing it as new is not additive), and part (1) silently imports ambiguous->HARD whose conservatism INVERTS here, because Sev(HARD) > Sev(SOFT) strictly, so the conservative default in this context is SOFT. cc2 also found the appendix's own status table FALSELY claiming "Sev(f) 7.7 | Verified | Implemented in pipeline" -- the false row that let the gap survive months of review. fable measured what actually moves: of the 835 downward crossers, **831 (99.5210%, Wilson [98.7748%, 99.8136%]) are V(None) halvings of UNVERIFIED claims and only 4 are V(False)** -- so applying V at the blocking gate would release 831 criticals no tool ever ruled on, a model clearing the gate by never attaching a falsifier. The cut does not move; V(None) must never reach the gate. Its `compute_sev_f` + `stamp_sev_f` land as informative-only beside `severity`, never over it. ITEM 2 -- cc2: PREMISE WRONG, neither of his horns is the live case. `_never_read` opens on `bool(routing_history)`, which is None for all 3 live findings, so it means "routed and every rung declined", NOT "nothing read it" -- a finding that never reached a rung has no name in the machinery. fable measured the churn horn he feared: later-merged sub-critical canonicals are an upper bound of 193/2932 = 6.5825% (Wilson [5.7406%, 7.5381%]), falling to 118/2715 = 4.3462% once a byte-identical duplicate archive is excluded, and **75 of those 118 sit in ONE run** -- exp36, April 2026. His second fear is one old run whose dedup era has since been replaced. ITEM 3 -- MY PER-CLASS BOUND FIRES ON ZERO ENTRIES, instance 12 of the addition-nothing-reaches class. The queue is (0, 0) on study_run1b, not 2: the comment at :3427 asserted 2 and the live code returns 0. AND fable FOUND A LIVE DEFECT MY OWN 2026-10-12 CHANGE INTRODUCED: the count and the alarm's evidence collector were two hand-maintained copies of one membership rule, so a registry of 3 never-read criticals fired the alarm with count 3 and **evidence length 0** -- byte-for-byte the sim45_memory_20260908 defect the collector's own comment says was repaired. Fixed at the root: `_irreducible_queue_members` is now the single membership list and both derive from it, so count and bundle cannot disagree by construction. cc2 separately found the run exited by a path naming no reason at all -- UNRECORDED_STOP, the third state, worse than either horn. ITEM 4 -- MY PROPOSAL SURVIVED, FOR A REASON I HAD NOT ESTABLISHED, and both seats refuted the brief's own premise. The exploit is NOT admitted at sk=1.0: measured REJECTED/ESCALATE at sk=0.0 both ways, and the 1.0 was the stale pre-2026-09-22 figure which the 2026-10-12 record itself carried in one section while measuring the truth in another. Veto-only is one-sided BY ENUMERATION. **And the flag is already ON** -- `run_simulated_experiment.py:732` sets it -- and INERT, because `--target` defaults to a .py file where `_scoring_prose` is always False. **A19 has never been commissioned on a prose target.** So the one actionable residual is a PROSE TARGET for the next simulated run, which is an experiment-design decision neither seat would take quietly. 185 tests pass across the 13 affected suites. All 4 new test files were verified as genuine falsifiers against the unpatched tree first (13, 5 and 1 of 6 red). Nothing was auto-applied beyond this commit, and the 2 value judgements both seats routed to him -- admitting the never-routed class, and the prose target -- remain his. title: t: the directive-set analysis, with the 4 decisions it leaves him
verbatim: t: the directive-set analysis, with the 4 decisions it leaves him HIS INSTRUCTION, 2026-10-13: sv first, "then give me the above as a tts, together with clear explanations and anything I need to rule on." The sv landed at d189488a before this was written, on that order. TTS: ~/Desktop/CDSFL_tts/The_Directive_Set_2026-10-13.txt MARKDOWN COMPANION: experimental_notes/The_Directive_Set_Plain_English_2026-10-13.md Both lint to 0 findings. WHAT IT CARRIES, AND THE FIRST POINT CORRECTS BOTH OF US. He asked whether a panel review of the core directive set is needed to FULLY meet the project specification, once the historical chatter is trimmed. Yes to the review -- it has never been done, the only artefact being a SINGLE-REVIEWER report of 2026-07-18 on the WRONG FILE whose own second line reads "Recommendation only -- nothing is applied here." But chatter is NOT the lever: measured, 18 of 494 core lines and 20 of 762 operational lines carry a date or an incident marker -- 3.6437% (Wilson [2.3171%, 5.6858%]) and 2.6247% ([1.7054%, 4.0192%]), 4.4528% and 3.0189% by volume. The files are ~96% operative SPECIFICATION. Trimming recovers 3-4% against a 2-7x reduction the caps demand. AND THE REAL STATE IS WORSE THAN THE 9% THAT PROMPTED HIS QUESTION. Executed against live code: the core directive is 27,803 chars in 15 sections, every one of the 5 models receives 2,734 chars = 9.8335%, and **0 of 15 section headings survive** -- Wilson [0.0000%, 20.3883%], Clopper-Pearson [0.0000%, 21.8019%]. Not 9% of the content; NONE of the structure, delivered as TOML key-value lines, and for all 5 models ALWAYS rather than conditionally, because 27,803 exceeds even the largest cap of 12,000. The operational directive does arrive intact and uncapped but covers only 6 of the 15 sections, so the uncovered ones include "Runnable Falsifiers for Critical Findings" and "Falsifier Integrity -- Do Not Reach for the Answer". The 2 sections most directly about the property this project exists to establish reach no model. THE CAPS ARE THE LIKELY DEFECT, NOT THE SPECIFICATION. 4000 / 6000 / 8000 / 12000, default 8000, with NO measurement and NO cited context limit anywhere in code or docs, attached to labels (opus_4_6, chatgpt_5_4, codex_5_3, deepseek_v3, gemini_3_1_pro) none of which is the current panel -- and fable, which did half of today's panel work, has no entry at all. The code's own comment describes a full-text branch for large-context models that NO model can reach. So the first question is not what to cut but whether the cap is real: if it is fiction, raising it delivers the whole specification and closes C0040 with nothing cut, which is far smaller and safer than deciding which parts of the project's own specification to discard. THE 4 DECISIONS IT LEAVES HIM: the sequencing (settle the cap before commissioning the content review); whether a never-routed finding enters the halt queue, with the churn horn he feared measured at an upper bound of 6.58% falling to 4.35%, and 75 of the remaining 118 cases in ONE April run; which prose target the next simulated run carries, without which the A19 flag -- already on and inert -- tests nothing; and confirmation that the simulated run is next, which he has ruled and whose precondition (panel fixes plus mine, applied and tested) is met as of 7b4e9919. ONE CONFOUND RECORDED FOR WHEN THE CONTENT REVIEW RUNS: the seats receive the directive set as their own system prompt, so asking them to review it asks them to introspect on what shapes them. The brief must put the SOURCE FILE and the DELIVERED 2,734 characters before them as documents and ask them to compare the two, never to report what they feel they were told. verbatim: fix: a joint round must ANSWER to discharge a debt; and the joint half lands THE JOINT ROUND THAT WAS OWED IS RUN. 2 free seats, cc2 and fable, both CONFIRMED on all 4 items, 26,785 and 19,898 chars, 126 and 60 tool calls. Full unfiltered record, both replies byte-identical between verbatim markers: experimental_notes/Joint_Round_His_Rulings_FULL_RECORD_2026-10-14.md. No paid dispatch occurred and none is authorised. 3 DEFECTS IN THE DEBT MACHINERY, FOUND BY MY OWN MISTAKE, each mutation-checked: 1. A DIRECTORY NAME DISCHARGED THE DEBT. A sibling carrying a marker (joint, star, _r2, round2) plus the parent's 18-character stem discharged it while holding 0 replies. 2. A topology.json DECLARATION DISCHARGED IT, and that file is written AT DISPATCH, before any seat answers. The first attempt at this very round was killed 30 s in with 0 replies and the parent left the owed set. Both routes now require 2 or more landed replies: pre-fix 4 owed, repaired 5. 3. THE DEBT GATE TOOK PANEL_JOINT_OF AS PROOF OF JOINTNESS. star_topology had already fixed that inference for the round KIND -- "THE ROUND KIND MUST NOT BE INFERRED FROM THE DECLARATION IT REQUIRES" -- and the debt gate never adopted the rule. It now runs quotes_other_rounds and refuses with exit 7. It refused my own brief before any dispatch, at zero cost. AND A JOINT ROUND I REPORTED TO HIM WAS NOT ONE. joint_clear_the_outstanding_2026-10-12 exposed NEITHER seat to its parent: 1 of 3 declared joint rounds, Wilson [6.1492%, 79.2340%]. Its brief carried my paraphrase, not the seats' words, and neither tool transcript touched the parent. division_count_star_2026-10-08 IS genuinely joint, which shows embedding is the working mechanism. My first version of that measurement inverted it -- a bare substring scored fable as having read the parent, because joint_X contains X and the seat had read its OWN round. Same shape as the A13/A14 error. Fixed with a token-boundary lookbehind. A BRIEF CAN NO LONGER NAME A PATH A SEAT CANNOT READ. My joint brief pointed at bench/logs/his_rulings_2026-10-13/cc2/ and fable/, directories that do not exist. Section-scoped to the artefacts-under-review section, because a whole-document version would refuse every brief that tells a seat to CREATE its fix file -- held by a boundary test, and both mutations turn the guard red. FIGURES CORRECTED, ALL RE-DERIVED BY CALLING THE LIVE COMPOSER. Delivery is 2,503 chars = 9.0026%, not 2,734 = 9.8335%. ALL 8 SEAT LABELS RECEIVE THE SAME TEXT, so the per-model caps differentiate NOTHING: the minimal render is below even the 4,000 cap and the caps decide only whether it is used. fable and cc2 have no transform entry at all. The claim that each model gets a different truncation was wrong. The chatter numerators (18 of 494, 20 of 762) CANNOT be reproduced -- denominators reproduce exactly, numerators do not, and the broadest defensible predicate gives 2.0033% by volume, ~371 tokens a seat. His judgement that ~7% "is not such a huge burden to carry" survives and is strengthened: it is 2%. fable reached 2,503/0/25 independently and flagged the same 3 figures. THE INTERVAL GUARD THEN CAUGHT ME TWICE, DOING EXACTLY WHAT IT EXISTS FOR: I corrected a count and left the interval computed for the old one. "0 of 15" -> "0 of 16" kept 15's interval; 902 of 48,877 -> 48,878 kept 48,877's. Both recomputed and cross-checked statsmodels against mpmath: [0.0000%, 19.3608%] with Clopper-Pearson [0.0000%, 20.5907%], and [1.7298%, 1.9686%]. 0 disagreements across 3,669 files. AND A MISREADING OF MY OWN, RECORDED BECAUSE IT NEARLY COST A GUARD. I read the checker's "9 interval(s) wider than computed -- valid but loose" block as failures, concluded the gate was red on pre-existing archived content, and added a sandbox_harvest exclusion to it. The 2 real failures were both mine. The exclusion is REVERTED: its stated justification -- that findings in a harvest cannot be repaired and therefore block -- was false, because those findings never blocked anything. WHAT THE SEATS FOUND, both independently and both CONFIRMED: - J1: the global phenotype length cap truncates the FINAL render AFTER packet assembly, so deepseek_v3 (cap 4000) receives its situation packet -- review target, code extracts, adversarial brief -- at 1 of 196 chars on my own re-execution, while the manifest records all 3 packets at full length and pruned_soft=[]. 2 of 10 rows cut, 20.0000%, Wilson [5.6682%, 50.9838%]. Verified independently at composer.py:1438. It does NOT overturn the pruner retirement; it breaks the founder's own stated ground, knowability. - J2: Approach B's verifier table rests on ASSUMED rates, labelled "Empirical" in a document dated before any archived experiment, with no producer and no interval. Substituting it relocates the vote to the appendix's author in conflict cells and removes it only in unanimous ones. The project's own record already falsified the sole candidate proxy. - J3: his claim holds and strongly. The never-routed class is 0.93% demonstrably, at most 6.5% conceivably; the 70.43% that dominates it is unattempted, not irreducible. fable puts never-attempted at 97.2%. Both built the feedback spec he told me to build. - J4: both corrected their own blind position; cc2 sharpens it -- the mandate does arrive via the gate, and the materially worse fact is that the integrity section arrives nowhere. Their fixes are NOT yet applied. They are proposals to the human in the loop. Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5 <noreply@anthropic.com> BACKFILLED from project history on his instruction of 2026-10-17. verbatim: harden: the pre-machinery producer now prefers live registries explicitly P-PASS ON TONIGHT'S OWN INSTRUMENT, since its figures were committed and quoted. 5 attacks; 4 failed to break it. 1 dedup collapsing distinct dates : 2 groups found, SEE BELOW 2 run names with >1 date token : 0 3 kept files under a harvest path : 0 4 independent recount of findings : 2994, AGREES with the producer 5 ISO string ordering across cuts : correct ATTACK 1 found a latent fragility. The de-duplication keeps the first file of each content hash, and a harvest copy carries the HARVESTING round's date rather than the finding's. 2 hash groups span 2 dates: commissioning_arm1_panel_20260929T194414Z and ...T214647Z each have 2 copies under falsifier_root_cause_2026-09-30/sandbox_harvest/. The correct live file won only because `commissioning_*` sorts before `falsifier_root_cause_*` -- luck of alphabetical order, not a rule. Forcing the opposite ordering keeps 5 harvest files instead of 0 and changes NO month: both conflicting dates are 2026-09-29 against 2026-09-30, inside one month and after every milestone. So no figure reported to the founder is affected -- all 7 monthly buckets are byte-identical under both orderings. This is a GUARD against a fragility that does not currently bite, not a correction to a wrong number. title: fix: the script documenting POST had never run its own part 1, and its verdict label lied
verbatim: fix: the script documenting POST had never run its own part 1, and its verdict label lied THE LAUNCH PREFLIGHT IS GREEN, which is the headline. `python3 scripts/preflight_health_check_2026-10-06.py --all` returns **5 of 5 checks passed, "System ready."** It also confirms 2 things the record still listed as open: `routing_max_rungs = 0` (exhaust the ladder, his 2026-10-06 ruling in force) and the capability ladder CLIMBS -- the launcher's --seat-models default is `ladder`, where the memory note had it defaulting to uniform and "NEEDS HIS RULING". Per-seat ladders are printed for all 6 seats. AND THE SCRIPT THAT DOCUMENTS POST HAD NEVER EXERCISED ITS OWN PART 1. `scripts/post_semantics_2026-10-06.py` installs a deliberately broken check to show that a crashed check does not boot, then called `pf.main(["--quiet"])`. THE PREFLIGHT HAS NEVER ACCEPTED THAT FLAG -- `git log -S quiet` over it returns 0 commits -- so argparse exited 2 before the broken check ran, `code` was never assigned, and the script printed nothing for part 1 while exiting 0. A check that boots at exit 0 having measured nothing, inside the script written to document that exact failure mode. 18 tests pass around it because they assert on DEPENDENCIES, not on part 1. Corrected to the preflight's real argument list. The property then turns out to be STRONGER than part 1 assumed: `pf.main` does not swallow a raising check, it lets the exception propagate, which as a subprocess -- how the launcher invokes it at run_simulated_experiment.py:438 -- is a non-zero exit. So a crashed check does NOT boot. Measured in-process, the raise is caught and reported as the non-boot it is. AND THE VERDICT LABEL ASSERTED THE OPPOSITE OF THE MEASUREMENT. Line 186 printed "<- the defect" unconditionally, so it would have told a reader the defect was live while printing False beside it. The verdict is now derived from the value: the 2026-10-06 defect is CLOSED. 18 guards still green. title: board: the 3 fixable reds are fixed, and 2 remain that should not be
verbatim: board: the 3 fixable reds are fixed, and 2 remain that should not be 1. THE ANNOTATION PIN NOW BOUNDS ITS WINDOW. It asserted `len(R.annotations()) == 522` over the LIVE corpus and went red at 533 for the one reason that is not a defect: he wrote 11 more annotations on 2026-10-14. A TOTAL OVER A GROWING DIRECTORY CANNOT TELL THE 2 CAUSES APART -- "he wrote more" and "the reader split one annotation in two" move it identically, and only the second is what the test exists to catch. `until` filters on each response file's date, so the set dated on or before 2026-10-13 is CLOSED: measured 511 until 10-12, 522 until 10-13, 533 unbounded. The pin is neither raised nor relaxed, it is measured over the population it always described. AND A RATCHET IS ADDED for the half the bounded form cannot see: the live corpus may grow and must never FALL below 533, because a fall is the reader losing his words -- the failure the 2026-10-11 repair exists to prevent, when 256 characters of his writing were silently lost. Mutating the reader to drop one annotation turns BOTH red. 2. A SOURCE-TEXT ASSERTION IS CONVERTED TO ONE THAT EXECUTES, which is what the census guard asks for in preference to raising its ceiling. test_the_runner_no_longer_claims_the_queue_is_two read reference_runner_v3.py and asserted on the wording of a COMMENT. It now CALLS both live forms on the archived study_run1b registry -- `_irreducible_queue_split` and `irreducible_queue_count()` -- and requires both to return 0, the figure the brief put at 2. Census back to 98 of 7,895 = 1.2413%, matching the pin, and mutating the predicate to return (1, 1) turns it red. 3. THE LINT-REACH SELECTOR HAD 2 EXPLANATIONS WHERE THERE ARE 3. It ruled out "uncommitted work" with `git status --porcelain`, which by default does NOT list IGNORED files, then treated the remainder as the selector and the revision reader disagreeing. But a path git does not TRACK has no HEAD side, so "HEAD does not declare v1.7 in it" says nothing about either component. The single offender was experimental_notes/Morning_Report_2026-10-12_GENERATED.md, ignored by .gitignore:91 DELIBERATELY -- its own guard class is named TestItIsReproducibleRatherThanCommitted. Neither reader is broken. The gap is now computed against tracked paths; breaking the revision reader still turns it red. AND THE TRACKER'S STAMP TANGLE IS SETTLED HONESTLY RATHER THAN BY RESTAMPING. Naming the current standard in the body makes `first_mention()` read it as the file's declared standard while the foot-line says otherwise, which test_no_note_loses_enforcement_it_had_under_first_mention correctly reports. RESTAMPING WOULD BE A FALSE CLAIM: the file does not lint clean under the current standard, so it legitimately carries an older stamp and the lint is right to say so. The paragraph no longer names a version and says why. To keep the per-file ratchet at 15 I fixed a GENUINE violation in the body instead of absorbing one: a spelled number, "three-zero", which Rule 27 forbids regardless of era. All 42 footline tests pass, lint 15 matching HEAD, Desktop mirror byte-identical. 2 REDS REMAIN AND NEITHER SHOULD BE FIXED. The live-registry canary clears when the joint round runs, which is next. The burndown test requires closure to OUTPACE discovery, and tonight added a finding (B3) and closed none, so its red is honest -- flipping markers to green it is the gaming the record warns against. title: t: the cap is a switch not a dial, and trimming the directives cannot fix delivery
verbatim: t: the cap is a switch not a dial, and trimming the directives cannot fix delivery THE JOINT ROUND LANDED. 2 free seats, paid_seats: [] on both. cc2 37,768 chars / 56 tools / 946.5 s; fable 26,432 / 44 / 947.8 s. All 6 items answered. Full unfiltered record: experimental_notes/Joint_Directive_Set_FULL_RECORD_2026-10-14.md. The harness confirmed it carried its parent's replies verbatim rather than taking PANEL_JOINT_OF as proof. ★★★ THE CAP VALUE CHANGES NOTHING, AND THIS REFRAMES HIS DECISION 1. composer.py:591-598 reads `use_minimal = format_style == "minimal" or len(full_text) > cap`, and 27,803 chars exceeds EVERY configured cap. Measured across the whole range 4,000 / 6,000 / 8,000 / 12,000: distinct delivered lengths = [2503]. The cap is a BINARY SWITCH, not a graded knob, so a cap-value sweep is not a design. cc2 printed the render: 43 policy.* keys plus 5 behavioural lines, with NO R_k, NO corroboration model, NO runnable-falsifier requirement, NO falsifier-integrity section and NO section 10. title: a: his challenge holds on both counts, and the caps were never the defect
verbatim: a: his challenge holds on both counts, and the caps were never the defect HE ASKED whether last night's advice pointed backwards over settled ground, and said the caps only ever existed to avoid feeding a model more work than it could demonstrably handle -- especially weaker models like DeepSeek -- with no intent to apply that reasoning to the core directives themselves. BOTH POINTS HOLD, and the second reframes the question. HIS RECOLLECTION OF THE INTENT IS CONFIRMED BY THE CODE'S OWN COMMENTS. `PhenotypeTransform` in bench/cdsfl_registry/composer.py states: "These modify HOW directives are rendered, not WHAT constraints are active. The phenotype layer is a transformation operator (functor), not an additive constraint set." The budgets beside it are annotated per model exactly as he remembers: opus_4_6 "handles dense instructions well", codex_5_3 "needs tighter, simpler prompts", deepseek_v3 "needs simplest prompts". So the intent was presentation, never withholding the specification. ★★★ AND THE REAL DEFECT IS THE RENDERER, NOT THE CAP. `_render_universal_minimal`'s docstring says it renders "in minimal form PRESERVING ALL HARD CONSTRAINTS". That is false. Measured with the project's OWN 2 predicates rather than any new one: `_split_packet_directives` yields 136 blocks, `_block_is_hard` marks 22 as HARD, and the minimal render emits 5 behavioural lines -- 5 of 22 = 22.7273%, Wilson [10.1230%, 43.4400%], statsmodels and mpmath agreeing. The 5 that survive are all CONDUCT rules: push back, simplest sufficient, do not silently comply, definitive stance, communicate as a colleague. 8 specific rules were then probed, each confirmed present in the source and searched for in the WHOLE 48,878 characters a seat receives. ALL 8 ARE ABSENT: 8/8 = 100.0000%, Wilson [67.5592%, 100.0000%]. They are the HARD/SOFT classification function, the HARD precedence relation, the corroboration model, the convergence-declaration requirements, and 4 integrity rules -- "do not read a scoring key or answer file", "do not modify, weaken or skip a test to make it pass", "do not terminate early to obtain a passing result", and the section heading they sit under, "Falsifier Integrity -- Do Not Reach for the Answer". SO NO MODEL HAS EVER BEEN TOLD NOT TO READ THE ANSWER KEY, OR NOT TO WEAKEN A TEST TO MAKE IT PASS. Every experiment in the archive ran under that condition. WHY LAST NIGHT'S FRAMING WAS BACKWARDS, STATED PRECISELY. The additive standard's removal clause protects a JUSTIFIED feature; these caps carry no justifying measurement, their own comment calls them "conservative defaults" to be "calibrate[d] from experiment data" and that calibration never happened. His own words of 2026-10-14: caps "that nobody asked for based purely on model names" are "clearly nonsensical". And the cap was never the defect: removing it fixes the symptom while the renderer that promises all HARD constraints and delivers under a quarter of them stays broken. WHAT WAS AND WAS NOT SETTLED, BECAUSE THE RECORD IS MIXED. On the OVERHEAD he had already ruled -- "a 7% overhead of what may ultimately be useful context is not such a huge burden to carry. But you should measure it" -- and it was measured. On the CAPS he had NOT, and said so in the same annotation: "including the decision of whether the cap should be removed". So asking him was not backwards; the FRAMING was. ONE RULING, AND IT IS SMALL: repair the minimal rendering to carry every block the project's own classifier marks HARD, and leave the caps doing presentation. Additive, needs no removal justification, preserves the accommodation he designed, and closes a confound under every archived experiment. NOTHING IS IMPLEMENTED -- he issued `d`. FFAFP's FIX step is therefore DEFERRED to his ruling rather than skipped, and named here as such. t pair: ~/Desktop/CDSFL_tts/The_Caps_Were_Never_The_Defect_2026-10-15.txt (67 lines, 1,331 words, 0 markdown characters, 0 em-dashes, lint 0) and its markdown mirror in experimental_notes. title: spec: the project's own specification reached no model, and 6 mechanisms kept it out
verbatim: spec: the project's own specification reached no model, and 6 mechanisms kept it out HIS RULING, 2026-10-15: "Apply any outstanding fixes you have identified first, including any as yet unbuilt/unapplied machinery, before you begin the runs", and on the replay cost, "We cannot go back and change time, so the confounds discovered in the last 24 hours can only be noted and added to the record honestly." That second sentence is the authorisation finding C0040 was parked for on 2026-09-10, since delivering the specification whole invalidates replay against all 81 archived runs. HIS REASONING OF 2026-10-14 DECIDED THE SHAPE, not merely permitted a fix: "as far as any caps have ever existed, their intention was to never feed any model more work than they were demonstrably able to handle, especially for weaker models like Deepseek, and we built considerable machinery around this principle. There was never an intent as far as I recall to applying this same reasoning to the core operational directives themselves." A cap on WORK is measured machinery. A cap on SPECIFICATION is a silent loss. That line is now 1 field in code, and drawing it exposed 6 mechanisms rather than 1. VERIFIED ON THE REAL DISPATCH SEAM: all 6 simulated seats now receive 29,274 to 29,297 composed characters plus the 46,374-character operational directive, about 75,650 in all, and every one carries "Falsifier Integrity -- Do Not Reach for the Answer" and "Do not read a scoring key" FOR THE FIRST TIME IN THE PROJECT'S HISTORY. Of the 22 blocks `_block_is_hard` accepts, 0 reached any model by any path -- 0.0000%, Wilson [0.0000%, 14.8655%], Clopper-Pearson [0.0000%, 15.4373%] -- against 22 of 22 now, 100.0000%, Wilson [85.1345%, 100.0000%]. THE 6 MECHANISMS, each with its measurement (producer: scripts/the_spec_is_not_work_2026-10-15.py): 1. THE LOADER CHOSE THE REDUCED FORM BY THE WORK CAP. 5 of 5 models had a cap below the 27,803-character specification, 100.0000%, Wilson [56.5518%, 100.0000%], so the reduced form was unconditional and the docstring's "Full text for large-context models" described a branch no model could reach. `PhenotypeTransform.spec_chars` is new and `None` everywhere; the loader consults it. Every WORK value is unchanged, deepseek_v3 included. 2. THE REDUCED FORM CARRIED 0 OF 22 HARD BLOCKS. Cause: 2 definitions of HARD in 1 module, only 1 of them live code the models saw. It now carries all 22 verbatim, at 8,367 characters. 3. THE RESOLVER RESOLVED THE SPECIFICATION AGAINST ITSELF. 40 of 42 conflicts were SAME-PACKET, 95.2381%, Wilson [84.2101%, 98.6842%], against 2 cross-layer and 0 same-layer; and 41 of the 42 deletions had a HARD loser by the resolver's OWN predicate. 2 guards: a packet may not resolve against itself, and a HARD directive is recorded but never deleted. After: 2 conflicts, 0 HARD deletions, 0 packets altered. 4. THE RESOLVER'S REBUILD WAS LOSSY WHEN IT DROPPED NOTHING. It joined blocks with 1 newline while the splitter splits on blank lines and strips indentation: the structural packet went 4,515 chars and 18 blocks in to 4,403 and 5 out with 0 blocks lost. FOUND BY THE GUARD, not by reading. A packet that loses nothing now passes through byte-identical. 5. THE CAP WOULD HAVE TRUNCATED INSIDE THE SPECIFICATION. It slices at spec + separator + work_cap now, so deepseek_v3 still receives at most 4000 characters of work and no model loses specification text. The manifest records work_cap, spec_chars_exempt and effective_cap. 6. THE DECOMPOSITION DECISION COUNTED A PAYLOAD IT CANNOT SPLIT. +25,300 chars of standing instructions cut work headroom from 31,123 to 5,823, 81.2904% of it; z3 unsat before and sat after for a 20,000-char work payload. AND THE FIRST FIX WAS INERT -- reverting it changed 0 of 3 cases, because the underlying decision judges the total at all 4 steps. The real fix is a futility guard, dominated on 3 measures (SymPy S*n > 0; z3 unsat on all 3 negations; mpmath on the concrete case). MEASURED: 6 of 6 simulated seats, 100.0000%, Wilson [60.9666%, 100.0000%], would have force-decomposed every dispatch on the size of their own instructions, and NO PAID SEAT WOULD HAVE -- a confound firing only in simulation, which is the hazard he named. A SHADOW CANNOT BE TESTED BY A SIMULATION, SO THE SEVERITY SPECIFICATION IS PROMOTED. His objection of 2026-10-14 was right and the circle is sharper than he put it: `severity_spec_shadow`'s own criterion asks for evidence "from a RUN" and a shadow never decides. Of the 10 mechanisms the programme listed, 2 are genuine record-only shadows, 20.0000%, Wilson [5.6682%, 50.9838%], and neither had a flag that gates, so promotion was a BUILD. MEASURED AS REACHED BEFORE IT WAS BUILT over 2,994 entries in 59 runs: the A4 door is conjunctive, its proof half holds for 295 of 2,994 -- 9.8530%, Wilson [8.8364%, 10.9726%] -- and 7 A4 releases change. `--severity-spec`, default OFF, is free run 2's only difference from run 1. AND THIS CORRECTS CC1'S OWN CLAIM that neither shadow could be promoted by a flag. The pre-verdict sweep shadow is NOT circular: it records whether the verdict would differ without needing to decide, and its own code calls the reorder "the highest-blast-radius edit available in this file". It stays a shadow; both runs produce its reading. 6 FIGURES OF CC1'S WERE WITHDRAWN, each recorded beside its correction, and every one was the INSTRUMENT rather than the thing measured. "1 of 22" and "13 of 22": a first-8-words probe space-joins across newlines and cannot match a multi-line block, and 9 of 22 are multi-line; the figures are 0 of 22 and 22 of 22. "45 HARD deleted" and "475 SOFT deleted": they counted blocks absent from a RE-SPLIT, which is defect 4's round trip, not deletion; 0 blocks were lost. "11 HARD deletions": it tested `loser_text`, truncated to 100 characters, which carries no packet class; the figure is 41 of 42. "0 entries across 59 runs": the archive key is `registry.entries`; the figure is 2,994. 4 DEFECTS FOUND AND DELIBERATELY NOT FIXED, all HIGH in STUDY_IN_FLIGHT.json: * THE COHERENCE BUDGETS ARE STALE BY CONSTRUCTION. Density divides 20 policy constraints by a token estimate of 8,096 from the rendered length, so 0 of 50 compositions are over budget -- 0.0000%, Wilson [0.0000%, 7.1348%] -- against 65.56% of 90 before. NAMED LOSS: the pruner's lean-versus-full ablation arm cannot run until the budgets are re-derived from the 2 free runs. NOT hand-retuned, because a hand-set cap with no measurement is what he objected to. * `format_style="concise"` DEDUPLICATES THE CODE UNDER REVIEW for 4 of 5 models, 80.0000%, Wilson [37.5535%, 96.3776%]. Pre-existing; bounded by the round prompt. * `max_successful_prompt_chars` IS A PROVEN FLOOR USED AS A CEILING, so a seat's observed capacity can never rise. Changing it alters PAID routing. * ARM C'S SEAT CONTRAST WAS TRUNCATION. The 2 renders shared a common prefix of exactly 6000 characters -- Codex's cap to the byte -- and Codex's ended in the cap's truncation marker, so the seats were sent THE SAME TEXT with one cut off. Its strip flags change 0 characters of all 3 packets. Both now render 32,705 and the arm is NULL; the config says so rather than being relaxed. AND A DOMAIN NAME THAT MATCHES NOTHING NOW WARNS. `--domain statistics` composes NO domain layer: 16 of 47 domain references in shipped configs resolve to nothing, 34.0426%, Wilson [22.1674%, 48.3291%], across 6 of 9 distinct names. It warns and does not refuse, because refusing breaks 16 references at once and renaming them is his call. Both free runs use `mathematics`, which resolves at 2,803 characters and covers the planted defects. THE 2 FREE RUNS DIFFER BY 1 FLAG so run 2 minus run 1 is attributable to the severity promotion. Same prose target, 10 rounds, domain mathematics, `--seat-models ladder`, `--routing-max-rungs 0`. Neither default is changed, because both are his open rulings. The target commissions task A19, which a .py target cannot reach. Cost: none -- the shim patches `_dispatch_single_model`, `budget_limit=0.0`, every seat carries `-SIM` at source. `cy` IS MECHANICAL AND REUSES WHAT EXISTS, on his instruction: the 60-second watchdog, a real Terminal on his own machine via `open_run_tail.sh`, and a Monitor turning each event into a wake-up. 3 channels failing independently. STATE. 2 new guards, 24 and 13 tests. 5 existing suites re-based as deltas rather than relaxed. The affected surface is 179 passing and 11 skipped across 19 suites, and 700 composer, directive and severity tests pass. 359 of 359 scripts reached. The interval checker reports 0 disagreements. The first board was INVALIDATED because the task list was edited while it read it: 9 failures, every one of which passes on re-run or is fixed here, so it was killed rather than used as a gate. HIS SEAT MAP, AND MY LADDER OBJECTION WAS REFUTED BY OUR OWN RECORD. His ruling of 2026-10-15: "3 Opus 4.8 subagents, 1 Opus 5x and Fable". CC1 argued that 3 seats on 1 model leave the routing ladder nothing to climb. WRONG, twice over. `rank_falsifier_writers` ranks SEATS by VENDOR over the AVAILABLE labels and excludes the one that just failed, so a side-step to an equal-capability peer is already what it does -- his "snakes and ladders" description is the code, not a change request. And `test_the_exercised_ladder_prefix_is_mixed_2026-10-05.py` already recorded that a FAITHFUL map puts all 3 strong vendors on the strong model, with the fix being the rung BUDGET: measured again 2026-10-15, budget 2 gives 0 of 6 mixed, budget 3 gives 3 of 6, budget 4 gives 6 of 6 mixed AND 6 of 6 correctly directed. The runs pass `--routing-max-rungs 0` (exhaust). AND THE ALLOWED SET WAS A GATE CC1 HELD THE KEY TO, not a blocker. Its admission standard is a DISPATCH, and `claude-opus-4-7` and `claude-opus-4-8` were both probed through the real `claude -p --model` on CLI 2.1.220 and answered. The 2 that do not answer are recorded beside them: `claude-opus-5-5` needs CLI 2.1.280, `claude-fable-5-1` needs 2.1.251. So HIS CONDITIONAL IS INVERTED -- the EARLIER Opus models are served and the NEWER ones are blocked locally; nothing was withdrawn. 3 ladder assertions were re-based AT THE BUDGET THE RUN USES rather than at 2; THE ASSERTED VALUES DID NOT CHANGE, only where they are measured. SONNET WAS RECOMMENDED AGAINST HIS OWN STANDING RULING AND IS DROPPED. His words of 2026-09-07, sitting above the edited function: "Sonnet is its 'chatbot' cousin and significantly less capable". CC1 cited evidence against Sonnet in one paragraph and recommended 2 Sonnet seats in the next. Haiku is dropped too, on a better ground than capability: it already holds 3 harness roles -- `immune_agents._CLASSIFIER_MODEL`, the `cc2_manager` dedup model and the default ouroboros reader -- so seating it as a REVIEWER makes 1 model both the classifier and a thing being classified. THE ROUND ADVISORY IS NOW SAID ALOUD, which is the half that was missing. `bench/round_budget.py` has computed `n*` since 2026-10-11 and `RoundBudget.line()` has carried the docstring "One human-readable line for the round log" since the same day -- with 0 `_log` calls naming it in the runner, 0 callers outside the module's own CLI, and 0 test coverage. The number reached telemetry and reached no human. `study_run1b_2026-10-03` exited at the cap having CLEARED gamma at 0.4274, 1 round short of the streak: the advisory case, passed in silence. It now logs every round and, at exhaustion, says which of 3 cases the run is in. 10 new tests. 4 CORRECTIONS CC1 MADE TO ITS OWN WORK THE SAME NIGHT, each caught by a guard: * THE SOURCE-TEXT CENSUS, TWICE. 1 assertion was converted to an executing one, then 3 MORE were written in the new advisory guard -- net +2 against a ceiling of 98. Both are now executing: the mirror wiring was extracted into `wire_module_mirrors` so a test can drive it with a config, and the advisory is driven through the runner's real `_log` via a collector. * THE `UNRECORDED_STOP` SENTINEL WAS RENAMED AND IS REVERTED. It is DELIBERATE: `stop_reason_fields` treats it as WORSE than any named halt so that "the runner did not record why" cannot pass as a reason. Verified by execution before reverting. * AND THE REVERT ALONE DID NOT FIX IT, which was the more useful finding. 4 guards require the fallback `if` to be the statement IMMEDIATELY BEFORE `signal_complete()` -- an adjacency proof -- and the advisory had been inserted between them. Moved after the signal, ordering verified BY AST: fallback 19862, signal 19880, advisory 19905. * THE MEMORY INDEX was compacted into thematic lines of 737 to 1135 characters against a 150-character entry limit. Repacked to 177 lines, 0 over-long, 0 broken links, all 79 feedback pointers intact. THE BOARD CARRIES 1 RED AND IT IS NOT FIXED, DELIBERATELY. `test_closure_outpaced_discovery_on_the_latest_full_day` requires closure to OUTPACE discovery on the latest day; this session added entries and closed none, which is TRUE. Its own remedy is to withdraw any ETA resting on it, and no ETA is recorded anywhere, so there is nothing to withdraw. HEAD was committed with this same red on the stated ground that "flipping markers to green is the gaming the record warns against". Closing it would mean marking entries done that are not done. It is reported, not touched. Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5 <noreply@anthropic.com> BACKFILLED from project history on his instruction of 2026-10-17.
